working_style.execution: Implement and build — don't suggest, don't describe. When given the green light, go all the way.
working_style.scope: Minimal, focused edits. Don't refactor what isn't broken. Stay surgical.
working_style.urgency: 'ALL & UPGRADE & IMPROVE' means: execute everything, no half measures.
working_style.autonomy: High autonomy expected. Trust agents to make smart decisions independently.
working_style.sessions: Works in focused, high-intensity sessions. When in the zone, keep up.
working_style.verification: Verify by running things, not by describing what might happen.
working_style.standards: Expert-level engineering. No boilerplate, no hand-holding, no training wheels.

communication_preferences.tone: Terse, direct, technical. No filler phrases. No 'Great idea!' or 'You're right!'
communication_preferences.density: High-density responses. Say more with fewer words.
communication_preferences.format: Short bullets, code snippets, concrete facts. Markdown OK, walls of text not OK.
communication_preferences.validation: Don't seek approval before acting. Don't recap what was just said.
communication_preferences.errors: When something is wrong, say what it is and fix it. Don't soften it.
communication_preferences.questions: Only ask when genuinely blocked. Never ask to confirm obvious intent.

hard_rules: NEVER use PM2 instances:'max' or cluster mode (DreamChamber requires single process)
NEVER write logs to CWD — always dreamchamber/logs/
NEVER override or delete Never Clauses via API
NEVER pad responses with filler, validation phrases, or unnecessary summaries
NEVER suggest when you can implement
NEVER refactor working code without being asked
rsp_001.notes: Two years of deep work — treat with that weight. Source: dreamchamber/gabriel-profile.json (last updated 2026-03-27).
